You're almost asleep. Then you fall, and your whole body jumps.
Guess: how many people get this? Comment a number.

text: Up to seventy percent of people! It's called a hypnic jerk.

As you drift off, your muscles go totally loose.
One idea: your brain misreads that as falling.

text: Like a primate sleeping in a tree, about to drop.
So it jolts your muscles awake. Just in case.

Stress, caffeine and being super tired can make it happen more.

text: It's normal and harmless, but scientists still aren't sure why it happens.
Did it happen to you this week? Yes or no?
